name: Barbell Frankenstein Squat
steps: Stand with the bar balanced across your front shoulders and both arms extended forward at shoulder height.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart and brace your trunk with your chest upright.
Bend your hips and knees together to squat smoothly down while keeping your arms level and chest tall.
Drive firmly through your feet to stand back up without letting the bar roll forward.
tips: Keep your arms level and torso upright because leaning forward causes the bar to slip off your shoulders.
Keep your knees aligned with your toes throughout both descent and ascent.
